channel.title: Backstage
channel.description: What's running, right now — Nigerian news, entertainment, sports and business.

item.title: Champions League Draw: Real Madrid to Face Arsenal, PSG Drawn Against Barcelona
item.description: The 2026-27 Champions League league-phase draw in Monaco has paired Real Madrid against Arsenal and Inter Milan, while two-time reigning champions Paris Saint-Germain will face Barcelona and Manchester City.

item.title: Nigerian Exchange Climbs as Market Capitalisation Adds ₦305bn
item.description: The Nigerian Exchange All-Share Index gained 473 points on Thursday, adding ₦305.56 billion to market capitalisation, as trading resumed after the Eid al-Mawlud holiday.

item.title: NPFL Unveils EuroMatch as Title Sponsor in $7.5m Deal Ahead of New Season
item.description: The Nigeria Premier Football League has unveiled EuroMatch as its official title sponsor in a three-year, $7.5 million naming-rights deal, with the new season kicking off August 28.

item.title: Tinubu Swears In Abel Enitan as New Head of Civil Service of the Federation
item.description: President Tinubu has sworn in Abel Olumuyiwa Enitan as the new Head of Civil Service of the Federation, succeeding Didi Esther Walson-Jack, who retired at the mandatory age of 60.

item.title: Military Says About 150 Terrorists Surrender as Pressure Mounts in North-East
item.description: The Nigerian military says about 150 terrorists surrendered as sustained operations increase pressure on armed groups in the North-East.

item.title: Ogogo’s Family Announces August 31 Fidau as Nollywood Colleagues Pay Tribute
item.description: The family of late actor Taiwo Hassan, popularly known as Ogogo, has announced a Fidau prayer for August 31, as Nollywood colleagues including Yinka Quadri and Dele Odule pay emotional tribute to the veteran actor.

item.title: Tinubu Urges NLNG to Maximise Gas Reserves, End Flaring for Domestic Benefit
item.description: President Tinubu has urged the Nigeria Liquefied Natural Gas (NLNG) board to eliminate gas flaring and convert the resource into greater economic benefit for Nigerians, prioritising domestic gas utilisation.

item.title: ICPC Indicts Budget Office Over Inclusion of Fake Agency in 2026 Budget
item.description: The ICPC has indicted the Budget Office of the Federation over the inclusion of a fictitious agency in the 2026 national budget, deepening a widening scandal over fake agencies embedded in government structures.

item.title: NAFDAC Orders Recall and Destruction of Alcohol in Sachets and Small PET Bottles
item.description: NAFDAC has ordered the recall and destruction of alcoholic drinks packaged in sachets and small PET bottles, enforcing a long-planned phase-out aimed at curbing abuse and underage access.

item.title: Tinubu Orders Coordinated Rescue After Niger Mosque Mass Abduction
item.description: President Tinubu has ordered the military, police and DSS to launch an immediate coordinated operation to rescue victims of a mass abduction at a mosque in Niger State, calling the attackers “enemies of peace and humanity.”

item.title: Umahi Orders Arrest of Contractors Removing Asphalt on Benin-Asaba Highway
item.description: Works Minister David Umahi has ordered the arrest of any contractor found removing asphalt from existing carriageways, criticising the slow pace and poor handling of the Benin-Asaba Highway project.

item.title: Dangote Refinery Expands Free Fuel Delivery to Kano, Imo, Anambra, Nasarawa
item.description: Dangote Refinery has expanded its free petroleum product delivery initiative to Kano, Imo, Anambra and Nasarawa states, aiming to cut distribution costs and create room for lower pump prices.

item.title: Tinubu Renews Tenure of NAN MD and NTA DG for Another Three Years
item.description: President Tinubu has renewed the tenure of NAN Managing Director Ali Mohammed Ali and NTA Director-General Abdulhamid Dembos for another three-year term, effective October 2026.

item.title: Veteran Nollywood Actor Taiwo Hassan ‘Ogogo’ Dies at 66 After Cancer Battle
item.description: Veteran Yoruba Nollywood actor Taiwo Hassan, popularly known as Ogogo, has died at the age of 66 after a battle with stage-four cancer, his family has confirmed.

item.title: Premier League: Man United Fall at Hull, Brentford Thrash Spurs in Matchday Two
item.description: Manchester United slumped to a 2-0 defeat at Hull City and Brentford thrashed Tottenham 3-0 as the Premier League’s second matchday produced several surprises over the weekend.

item.title: Real Madrid Snatch Late 2-1 Win at Espanyol in La Liga
item.description: Substitute Carlos Espi struck in the 90th minute as Real Madrid came from behind to beat Espanyol 2-1 away in La Liga on Saturday.

item.title: SEC Proposes ₦30m Registration Fee, ₦2bn Capital Requirement for Crypto Firms
item.description: Nigeria’s Securities and Exchange Commission has proposed a ₦30m registration fee and a minimum capital requirement of up to ₦2bn for digital asset exchanges and custodians under new draft rules.

item.title: Abiodun Receives Hundreds of PDP, ADC Defectors Into APC, Mobilises Ogun East for 2027
item.description: Ogun State Governor Dapo Abiodun has received hundreds of PDP and ADC members into the APC at a reception in Ijebu-Ode, consolidating the party’s hold on Ogun East ahead of the 2027 elections.

item.title: Tinubu Orders Arrest of Fake-Agency Promoter, Suspends Three Permanent Secretaries in ICPC Probe
item.description: President Tinubu has ordered the arrest of George Buchi Nwabueze and suspended three permanent secretaries after the ICPC uncovered another fake government agency operating inside the Office of the Secretary to the Government of the Federation.

item.title: Ayra Starr Releases Third Studio Album ‘Starrgirl’
item.description: Grammy-nominated Afrobeats star Ayra Starr has released her third studio album, “Starrgirl” — a 16-track project featuring Wizkid, Rema, ZAYN and Leon Thomas.

item.title: DR Congo Ebola Outbreak Passes 5,000 Cases, Becomes Deadliest in Country’s History
item.description: The WHO says the Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has passed 5,000 cases and killed more than 2,300 people — the deadliest and fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record.

item.title: EFCC, ICPC Probe ₦12bn Federal Government Intervention Fund Released to NFF
item.description: Nigeria’s two anti-graft agencies are investigating how the Nigeria Football Federation used a ₦12bn FG intervention fund meant to clear players’ wages and bonuses, after the NFF cited the probe in declining an FOI request.

item.title: Presidency, Wike Reject Atiku’s Pledge to Restore Petrol Subsidy if Elected in 2027
item.description: The Presidency and FCT Minister Nyesom Wike have rejected Atiku Abubakar’s pledge to restore petrol subsidy if elected president in 2027, describing the proposal as inconsistent and fiscally regressive.

item.title: UK Warns Citizens Against All Travel to 11 Nigerian States Over Insecurity
item.description: The UK’s FCDO has updated its Nigeria travel advisory, warning against all travel to parts of 11 states and all-but-essential travel to 19 more states and the FCT, citing terrorism, kidnapping and intercommunal violence.

item.title: 2027 Campaign Season Opens With Tinubu Facing Reform Test
item.description: As Nigeria’s pre-2027 election campaign period begins, President Bola Tinubu faces growing scrutiny over the economy and insecurity, including a surge in mass kidnappings.

item.title: Adeleke Receives Certificate of Return, Pledges Scholarships for Electoral Violence Victims
item.description: Osun Governor Ademola Adeleke received his Certificate of Return from INEC and pledged scholarships for the children of those affected by electoral violence.

item.title: Burna Boy Earns Two Nominations for FIFA World Cup Song With Shakira
item.description: Nigerian star Burna Boy has received two nominations for “Dai Dai,” his collaboration with Shakira on the official 2026 FIFA World Cup song.

item.title: Analysts See Stronger Market as CBN Reviews OMO and Eases Liquidity Access
item.description: Analysts expect a stronger equities market as the Central Bank reviews its Open Market Operations and eases access to liquidity.

item.title: Enugu Police Arrest 12 Kidnappers Who Allegedly Killed Female Victim After Collecting Ransom
item.description: Police in Enugu State say they have arrested 12 kidnappers who allegedly collected large ransoms and then killed a female victim.

item.title: Fayose Says Obi’s Exit From ADC Weakened Opposition’s 2027 Chances
item.description: Former Ekiti Governor Ayodele Fayose says Peter Obi’s decision to leave the ADC effectively ended his 2027 presidential chances and handed Tinubu an advantage.

item.title: Federal Government to Announce Islamic New Year Public Holiday
item.description: The Federal Government is set to announce the public holiday to mark the Islamic New Year, with a list of observances expected.

item.title: Kaduna University VC Accuses ASUU of Misrepresenting Facts on Mass Resignation
item.description: The Vice-Chancellor of Kaduna State University has accused ASUU of misrepresenting facts over the reported mass resignation of lecturers.

item.title: NAICOM Revokes Universal Insurance Licence, Appoints Liquidator
item.description: The National Insurance Commission has revoked the operating licence of Universal Insurance and appointed a liquidator.

item.title: Naira Strengthens to Five-Month High Near ₦1,343/$ on Improved Dollar Supply
item.description: The naira firmed to about ₦1,343 per dollar at the official market — its strongest level in roughly five months — as dollar liquidity improved.

item.title: NDLEA Arrests Influencer ‘KC Luxury’ Over Alleged ₦39bn Cocaine Cartel as He Tried to Flee to Paris
item.description: The NDLEA says it has arrested Lagos socialite and influencer Afolabi Kazeem Michael, known online as “KC Luxury,” over his alleged role in an international cocaine syndicate, after intercepting a record 184.5kg cocaine consignment.

item.title: Nigerian Stocks Fall for Seventh Straight Session, Shedding About ₦5 Trillion in a Week
item.description: The Nigerian Exchange extended its correction for a seventh consecutive session on Wednesday, with market capitalisation down roughly ₦5 trillion over the seven-day slide.

item.title: NHRC Records Nearly 355,000 Complaints in July, Warns Over Child Sexual Violence
item.description: The National Human Rights Commission recorded 354,997 complaints in July and raised the alarm over child sexual violence and digital rights abuse.

item.title: Nollywood Rallies Behind Veteran Actor Taiwo ‘Ogogo’ Hassan Amid Cancer Battle
item.description: Nollywood figures including Femi Adebayo and Odunlade Adekola have rallied support for veteran actor Taiwo Hassan, known as “Ogogo,” who is battling stage-four cancer.

item.title: Political Leaders Sign Peace Accord as 2027 Campaign Season Begins
item.description: Leading presidential figures signed a peace accord as campaigning for the 2027 general election formally began.

item.title: Police Report Arrests, Kidnap Rescues and Weapons Recoveries in 14 Operations Nationwide
item.description: The Nigeria Police Force reported arrests, rescues and weapons recoveries across 14 operations nationwide in its August 19 operational summary.
